cost_evidence: Nine CPU-pinned processes retain three alternating baseline/candidate pairs for five preserved workflows (three complete BRep modeling recipes, polynomial branches and the existing local/global polynomial-image APIs), plus three absolute processes for six new workflows. First and three repeated fresh-input calls retain all assertions, validation and output materialization. The legacy local/global projection recipe retains adverse first/repeated median latency ratios 1.041885/1.010552. Maximum measured process RSS is 23952 KiB. The matched native executable grows by 32336 bytes; all native/WASM artifact sizes and hashes are recorded. All unfavorable samples remain in cost-analysis.json and the raw record. The public Curve2/CurvePoint2/definition layouts remain identical to baseline; optional affine provenance adds one pointer to internal selected-fiber parameter data. Requested allocation traffic excludes foreign allocator internals and is not live heap. Shared-host timings and finite layouts establish neither a general speedup nor a total resource bound. New successful operations have no prior successful-work timing baseline.
limits: This is an exact selected-scalar and replay extension, not a completed general BRep section. The public solver enumerates local rational images; its caller must exclude poles and select the image of the retained source. The curve extension selects that image and exposes mixed affine forms of admitted PolynomialFiber points. General source-bound rational planar/spatial maps, branch derivatives and regularity, dual surface charts, filled arrangements, trim/material topology and whole-branch replay remain open. The underlying finite-fiber solver still rejects unsupported vertical/nullified components, generic repeated factors and whole boundary components. General rational-map persistence remains unsupported; the existing AffineForm archive covers the implemented affine source recipes. Existing degree caps, refinement/promotion counters and archive admission limits do not bound total arithmetic, coefficient growth, live heap, stack or cancellation latency. Runtime fuzz/ASan/lexicase, formal/coverage, MSRV, installed distributions, production bindings and the full pre-push matrix remain unqualified. All 28 work packages remain open/in-progress.
